correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all P² residue weights by divisibility and valuation v_P(a): if P∤a, degree≤M average 1−4/Q+2/Q², degree>M average 1−2/Q²; if P|a, averages 1−2/Q² for v=1 and 1−1/Q² for v≥2. Fresh independently written exact F₂[t] polynomial arithmetic exhaustively evaluated 320 local residue tests for eight irreducibles of degree≤4, eight nonzero shifts, five cutoff values. For any fixed finite set of P, CRT equidistribution of monic degree-n polynomials gives products; the omitted-square union tail ≤2∑_{d>K}2^(−d)/d uniformly after n sufficiently large. Only Q=2 gives a negative small-prime factor, giving sign via roots of a in F₂; no local factor vanishes. The finite-field prime-counting identity yields ∏_{degP≤M}(1−1/Q)∼e^(−γ)/M and absolutely convergent quotient factors 1+O(Q^(−2)), hence quartic scaling. The order of limits n then M is essential and respected.
